name: ds-superbot
description: DS Super Bot for DeepSeek Harness: a long-lived engineering team behind one lead agent. Seven role charters (pm / architect / backend-dev / frontend-dev / qa-engineer / browser-tester / reviewer) are injected at dispatch time instead of registering user-selectable agent presets; `superbot_dispatch` starts every child on the shipped `standard` composition, routes models from <project>/superbot.config.json over the Settings page, and refuses backend-dev / frontend-dev dispatch until a docTier=3 project holds a valid documentation receipt. `superbot_board` mirrors the plan onto the Agent Teams shared task board. The client half adds a per-session right-sidebar team panel (layer graph by default, artifacts collapsed, native task-progress counter, no copied task list), a Settings → Super Bot table for per-role model and reasoning effort, and the /superbot-roster command. The package also ships 13 native skills — the Tech Lead playbook, four documentation entry points behind a hard readiness gate, documentation governance, and five light discipline skills.
author: Lin

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check client.js && node --check scripts/docs-ready.mjs && node --check scripts/lib/docs-state.mjs
